{{Use dmy dates|date=November 2019}} {{Infobox football league season | image = | competition = [[Zambia Super League]] | season = 2019–20 | winners = Nkana (13th Title) | promoted = | relegated = [[Mufulira Wanderers F.C.|Mufulira Wanderers]] [[Nakambala Leopards F.C.|Nakambala Leopards]] [[Kabwe YSA F.C.|Kabwe YSA]] | relegation = | continentalcup1 = [[2020–21 CAF Champions League|Champions League]] | continentalcup1 qualifiers = | continentalcup2 = [[2020–21 CAF Confederation Cup|Confederation Cup]] | continentalcup2 qualifiers = | best player = | league topscorer = [[James Chamanga]] (16 goals) | best goalkeeper = | biggest home win = [[Zanaco F.C.|Zanaco]] 5-1 [[Nakambala Leopards F.C.|Nakambala Leopards]] | biggest away win = [[Kabwe YSA F.C.|Kabwe YSA]] 1-6 [[Green Eagles F.C.|Green Eagles]] | highest scoring = Kabwe YSA 1-6 Green Eagles | matches = 243 | total goals = 491 | longest wins = | longest unbeaten = [[Nkana F.C.|Nkana]] (8 Matches) | longest winless = [[Mufulira Wanderers F.C.|Mufulira Wanderers]] (15 matches) | longest losses = | prevseason = [[2019 Zambian Super League|2019]] | nextseason = [[2020-21 Zambia Super League|2020–21]] | updated = August 29,2020 }} The '''2019-20 Zambia Super League''' is the 59th season of the [[Zambia Super League]], the top-tier [[association football|football]] league in [[Zambia]]. This is the first Super League season that has a new format which conforms with the [[Confederation of African Football|CAF]] calendar.{{Cite web|url=http://www.league321.com/zambia-football-current-league-tables.html|title=Zambia Football Current League Tables|website=Football League Tables Results & Statistics|language=en|access-date=2019-09-13}} The league kicked off on 31 August. [[ZESCO United F.C.|Zesco United]] are the defending champions and [[Kabwe Youth Soccer Academy F.C.|KYSA]] and [[Kansanshi Dynamos F.C.|Kansashi Dynamos]] are the newly promoted sides into the super league.{{Cite web|url=https://futaa.com/zm/article/189856/zambia-superleague-2019-2020-season-fixtures-released|title=Zambia Superleague 2019/2020 season fixtures released|last=Futaa|website=futaa.com|access-date=2019-09-09|archive-date=22 September 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190922220134/https://futaa.com/zm/article/189856/zambia-superleague-2019-2020-season-fixtures-released|url-status=dead}} On 19 March 2020, the season was temporarily suspended by [[Football Association of Zambia|FAZ]] due to the effects of the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Zambia|COVID-19 pandemic]].{{cite web|url=https://supersport.com/football/zambia/news/200320_Faz_halts_Zambia_Super_League_over_coronavirus_fears |title= FAZ halts Zambia Super League over Coronavirus fears|work= [[SuperSport (South African TV channel)|SuperSport Football]] |date=19 March 2020}} On 26 June, after nearly four months of the league's suspension, the [[Football Association of Zambia|FAZ]] announced that the league would resume on 18 July 2020 [[Behind closed doors (sports)|behind closed doors]]. The rescheduled matches would be played first, then the league will fully resume on 1 August 2020 with Round 26 fixtures and is scheduled to be completed on 30 August 2020.{{Cite web|title=Zambia Super League back with a bang this weekend|url=https://supersport.com/football/zambia/news/200717_Zambia_Super_League_back_with_a_bang_this_weekend|access-date=2021-05-20|website=supersport.com|language=en}} ==Teams== {{location map+ |Zambia|width=700|float=right|caption='''Locations of the 2019–20 Zambian Super League teams''' |places= {{location map~ |Zambia|lat=-12.1669|long=26.3840|label= '''[[Solwezi]] teams:'''
